message: The other night, we experienced a surprise blackout, and while most of my neighbors were scrambling for flashlights, I was in my living room, basking in the glow of my trusty lantern. You see, I may be a bit gloriously over-prepared when it comes to power outages. I had my phone charged, snacks ready, and even a few board games lined up for entertainment. While others were wondering how to keep the kids entertained, we were playing charades by lantern light! It’s times like these that remind me being prepared can turn a gloomy situation into a cozy family night. How do you keep the fun alive during outages?
